csv_scope_of_work: Request for Qualifications Facilities Assessment Study The Town of East Brookfield requires engineering and related consulting services to comprehensively review existing building structural, building envelope, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems, site condition and recreational asset conditions at Town facilities and identify items requiring rehabilitation, replacement and/or maintenance. The Town seeks statements of qualification from interested firms meeting the required qualifications. East Brookfield has been awarded funds from the FY 2025 Massachusetts Executive Office of Livable Communities' Community Development Block Grant program to complete this study. The Town of East Brookfield encourages participation by respondents who are DBE/MBE/WBE or HUD Section 3 business enterprises.

title: East Brookfield Facilities Assessment Study
short_description: Facilities assessment study for town buildings, sites, and recreational assets in East Brookfield.
project_scope: Comprehensive assessment study of existing town facilities, including building structural systems, building envelope, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems, as well as site conditions and recreational assets. The study is intended to identify rehabilitation, replacement, and maintenance needs.
services: Engineering and related consulting services for a facilities assessment study; feasibility studies; planning/master planning; condition review and reporting for municipal facilities and assets.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a facilities assessment and feasibility/planning study, not a structural design commission.
- Includes broad building systems review, with strong focus on MEP and maintenance needs.
- No new bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building design component is indicated.
- Project type aligns with excluded categories such as feasibility studies and pure consulting/planning rather than sbp core structural engineering services.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice concerns a study funded through FY 2025 CDBG and only covers assessment of structural, envelope, MEP, fire protection, site, and recreational assets; no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The procurement is for an RFQ for consulting and assessment services only, without stated budget, fee schedule, or scope breakdown sufficient for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Interested firms must submit statements of qualifications demonstrating required qualifications for engineering and related consulting services for a facilities assessment study. Participation by DBE/MBE/WBE and HUD Section 3 business enterprises is encouraged.
